svg.aria-label: Prompt caching: hit skips the repeated prefix
svg.title: Prompt caching: hit skips the repeated prefix
svg.desc: Two lanes. Lane 1, cache hit: a static prefix such as a long system prompt sits before a cachePoint; the cache stores the processed prefix; a new request with the same prefix hits the cache and skips recomputation, which lowers cost and latency. Lane 2, cache miss: when the prefix changes, the cache misses and the model processes the full prompt again.
svg.text: PROMPT CACHING: PAY ONCE FOR THE STATIC PREFIX
skip recompute: lower cost, lower latency
1. Put the long unchanging text first: system prompt, few-shot examples, document dumps.
3. Bedrock caches the processed prefix. Later calls with the same prefix reuse it.
4. Keep the changing part (the user question) after the cachePoint.
Exam verb: repeated prefix means caching. Order matters: static first, changing last.
If the prefix changes every call, caching buys nothing. The prefix must repeat to pay off.
